necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
